meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Temu's app strip, countdown timers, deals strip and trust banner; blur or hide product pictures
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, real Chrome (headless) on www.temu.com (the Sri Lanka English storefront, redirected by region) with iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA, DOM captured after 7 seconds. Temu uses hashed CSS classes (`_3qNb0U--`, `banner-3ItBH`) almost everywhere, so rules rely on role="timer", an id, aria-label text, an href path and the CDN image file name; none uses a hashed class. Fixtures `real.html` and `desktop-real.html` are sanitised excerpts (text and product titles stripped, needed ancestors only, `data-keep` on the role=main region).

LIVE phone: the download module (`div:has(> div > button[aria-label="close download module"])`) 1, `a[href*="whychoosetemu"]` 1, `img[src*="-goods."]` product pictures 6. LIVE desktop: `[role="timer"]` 5, `#js-home-ChanelEntrySpike` 1, `#mainSidebar` 1, product pictures 2. The original cookie, ad and app-banner rules matched nothing.

Choices: Product pictures Show/Blur/Hide.

The aria-label rule is English-only and may differ in other storefronts. Temu serves a different layout, prices and popups by country; popups (coupon wheels, sign-in modals) did not appear in these logged-out headless captures and are not covered.

NOT verified: product pages, the cart and checkout, search results, any popup or modal, prices (no stable hook), other regions.
